name: yatmo-sdk-js
description: Workspace of the Yatmo JavaScript packages: @yatmo/sdk (API client, isomorphic) and @yatmo/maps (browser plugins).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yatmo/sdk && npm run build -w @yatmo/maps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @yatmo/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @yatmo/maps
